entries.name: QMSdesk
entries.summary: QMSdesk is a cloud eQMS for life sciences covering document control, quality events, CAPA, change control, training, risk and audits.

leaf_matches.reason: QMSdesk 官方首页正文明确为面向生命科学的 cloud eQMS，列出 quality events（偏差/投诉/OOS）、CAPA、change control、audit management、risk management、audit trail/e-signatures 与文档/培训控制；与叶子要求的质量记录、闭环工作流和证据姿态一致。

entries.name: Greenlight Guru
entries.summary: Greenlight Guru is a MedTech quality and product lifecycle platform with design controls, DHF, risk management, traceability and post-market quality/complaint management.

leaf_matches.reason: Greenlight Guru 官方首页正文描述 design controls/DHF、用户需求-要求-验证链接、ISO 14971 风险管理与端到端可追溯性，并覆盖从开发到 post-market 的器械生命周期；符合器械设计控制记录链与受控变更核心。

entries.name: Veeva Product Surveillance
entries.summary: Veeva Product Surveillance is a postmarket surveillance and incident reporting application for medical devices and diagnostics, with complaint handling, global reportability decisions and submission tracking.

leaf_matches.reason: Veeva 官方产品页正文明确面向医疗器械/诊断的 postmarket incident reporting management，含 complaint handling、global reportability decision tree、submission timeliness 与 complaint-handling metrics；覆盖现场安全事件评估/可报告性与监管提交跟踪核心。设备群体趋势/信号分析未在该快照明示，按边界收窄。

entries.name: Veeva Vault RIM
entries.summary: Veeva Vault RIM is a regulatory information management application for product registrations, submissions, dossiers, publishing, and health authority correspondence and commitments.

leaf_matches.reason: Veeva 官方产品页正文描述 Veeva RIM 统一 registration tracking、submissions、submissions archive、correspondence and commitments、dossier publishing；覆盖产品注册、提交/案卷与监管活动记录核心。

entries.name: SLIM Stability Management
entries.summary: SLIM is a stability study management application for protocol design, time-point scheduling, sample pulls, storage conditions, and shelf-life reporting.

leaf_matches.reason: SLIM 官方产品页正文明确为 complete stability study management software，含 Protocol Editor、time intervals/storage conditions、automatic time point scheduling、sample pull management、storage chamber inventory、shelf-life analysis 与 submission-ready reporting；符合研究/方案/抽取/结果核心。
